Privacy Policy

Printwell — printer and scanner app for iPhone and iPad · Effective date: 30 October 2026

Printwell (“the app”) is published by gokchetech (“we”, “us”), an independent iOS developer. Printwell was built to work on your device and over your own network. We do not run any server that receives, stores or analyses your documents, photos, scans or usage. This policy explains exactly what the app touches on your iPhone or iPad, and why.

At a glance

  • We collect no personal data through the app.
  • Documents, photos and scans go from your device straight to your printer over your own network. They are never uploaded to us.
  • No account, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking, no third-party SDKs.
  • Camera, photos and local network are used only for the features you choose.
  • Purchases are handled by Apple; we never see your payment details. We sell no data.

1. Data we do not collect

We do not collect, receive or store any personal data through Printwell. In particular:

  • There are no user accounts. You never sign up, sign in or give us an email address to use the app.
  • Your documents, photos, scans, recognised text, print history and printer list are never sent to us or to anyone else.
  • The app contains no analytics, crash-reporting, advertising or tracking SDKs, and it does not use the advertising identifier (IDFA). It never asks for permission to track you.
  • We do not sell, rent or share personal data, because we have none.
  • Printwell does not access your location, contacts, microphone or health data.

2. What the app uses on your device, and why

Printwell asks for permissions through the standard iOS prompts. You can change each one at any time in iOS Settings.

  • Local network: to find printers and scanners on your Wi‑Fi and to send print and scan jobs to them, and to show your printer’s ink, paper and error status. This access is used for nothing else.
  • Camera: only when you scan a document with the camera. Images are processed on your device and are not stored unless you save the scan.
  • Photos: when you print a photo, you pick it with the iOS photo picker, and Printwell receives only the photos you pick. When you save a scan or image to Photos, the app adds it without reading your library.
  • Files and documents: Printwell opens only the files you choose, or that you send to it with Print with Printwell in the share sheet.
  • Notifications: if you allow them, the app schedules a local reminder on your device, for example before a free trial ends. No notification server is involved.

3. Printing, scanning and web pages

Print jobs go directly from your device to the printer you choose, over your local network or Wi‑Fi Direct. Scans come directly from your printer’s scanner to your device. Text recognition (OCR) runs on your device with Apple’s frameworks. Your printer may keep its own job log, as printers do; that is outside our control.

When you print a web page, Printwell loads that page from the internet, as a browser would, so the website receives a normal request from your device. Templates are generated on your device; no template content is sent anywhere.

4. Data stored on your device

What you choose to keep stays in the app’s private storage on your device and in its shared container used by the share sheet action: saved scans and their recognised text, recent print jobs, the printers you added and your preferences. This data is protected by iOS app sandboxing and device encryption, and Printwell does not sync it to any server of ours. It is included in your device backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup) if you have turned those on; Apple handles those backups under its own terms. You can delete items in the app, and deleting Printwell removes all of its data from the device.

5. Sharing and exports

When you share or export a PDF, a scan or recognised text, the iOS share sheet sends it only to the destination you choose, such as Mail, Messages or Files. From then on, that recipient’s or service’s privacy terms apply. Nothing is shared automatically.

6. In-app purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple through the App Store. We never receive your name, Apple Account, payment card or billing address. The app checks with Apple’s StoreKit on your device whether your subscription is active. Apple provides us with aggregated sales reports that do not identify you. Apple’s handling of your purchase is described in the Apple Privacy Policy.

7. Information Apple may share with us

If you have turned on Share with App Developers in iOS Settings › Privacy & Security › Analytics & Improvements, Apple may share anonymised crash reports and usage statistics with us. We use them only to fix bugs. You control this setting. Ratings and reviews are handled by Apple.

8. Contacting us

If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you write, and use them only to answer you. Our mailbox is provided by Google (Gmail), which may store messages on servers outside your country. We delete support conversations when they are no longer needed, or sooner if you ask. The legal basis is your request and our legitimate interest in answering it (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and (f); KVKK Art. 5(2)(c) and (f)).

9. Children

Printwell is a general-audience utility. It includes printable worksheets and coloring pages that parents and teachers can print for children, but it is not directed at children and has no account, chat, advertising or social features. We do not collect personal data from anyone, including children under 13 (or the equivalent age in your country). If you believe a child has sent us personal data by email, write to us and we will delete it.

10. Your rights (GDPR, UK GDPR, KVKK, CCPA)

Depending on where you live, you have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or port your personal data, to object to its processing and to withdraw consent. Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), Article 11 gives you equivalent rights, including the right to learn whether your data is processed.

Because Printwell keeps your data only on your device, you exercise most of these rights directly: delete items in the app, or delete the app to remove everything. For support emails, write to us and we will answer within 30 days. You also have the right to complain to your data protection authority, for example your EU member state’s supervisory authority or, in Türkiye, the Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK).

We do not sell or share personal information as defined by the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), and we do not use it for targeted advertising.

11. Data controller

gokchetech, independent iOS developer. Contact: sengulfaruk1@gmail.com.

12. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, the new version will be published at this address with a new effective date. If a change affects how data is handled, we will also say so in the app’s release notes before it takes effect.
